strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed
Commander Gandal, how are the preparations for the operation?
No problem. We'll put it into action shortly.
King Vega is deeply disappointed by your repeated failures.
This time, live up to His Majesty's expectations.
I know that...!
(Grr, even if he is King Vega's favorite science commander,
I can't let him lord it over me any longer...
And I can't stand him being called the handsomest man on Vega either...)
All forces, hear me! The time has come! Our invasion of Earth begins!
Heh heh... From now on, the Earthlings will live in fear of attacks
from this Skull Moon Base!
(Still, to have to rush the operation like this...
I never imagined Earth's defense forces would do this well...)
Duuuuuuuke... Fleeeeeeeed!
Wh-What!?
Grendizer, GO!
Vega Star Federation! Now I'll avenge the people of planet Fleed!
So you've come, Duke Fleed!
You're a moth flying straight into the flame!
Recall Gorman and Zigra!
Beat the Earthlings' greatest force here, and our dream is within reach!
So this is it! When did they build such a huge forward base...!?
I'll settle this here...! Settle everything...!
Brother...
Whoa... Isn't the mood kinda intense?
...It's the enemy's home base. Still, getting too worked up is bad...
Calm down, Umon! The enemy won't run, so don't rush!
Yeah, yeah, looks like they're all fired up too!
Looks like their forces were just about to launch.
I've never seen Daisuke like that...
Looks like this is the final battle with the Vega Star Federation too...
Coming here in droves, all lined up!
...Infuriating, they've already sniffed this place out!
Heh heh, isn't this convenient, Commander Gandal...
Our biggest source of worry has jumped right into our hands.
What a base... So the reason they were so fixated on the Moon was...
Yeah, it was to build this base. ...They sure went all out.
Looks like they managed to finish building it... but we can't leave it be!
We'll now strike the Vega Star Federation's base! All units, launch!
What do you people think other people's planets are!?
Go back to your own planet!
If all you ever think about is bad stuff, you'll regret it later!
Grrr... Letting you talk only makes you cockier...
...Our planet... Vega... no longer exists in this universe!
...!? What did you say...?
What? What do you mean, Commander Zuril!?
You know it too, Duke Fleed...
Our Vega Nebula was contaminated by Vegatron radiation,
and its stars exploded one after another...!
Yes. ...D-Don't tell me!
That's right, even planet Vega has finally vanished!
We no longer have anything we can call home!
So that means... they're just like Daisuke...
Yet another people who lost their home world...
Truly their backs are to the wall... Be careful, all of you.
A cornered beast becomes many times more ferocious!
Ngh...! Then... then why won't you join hands
with the people of other planets!?
Don't fight! Let's think about it together!
That's right! It's because you attack us that we end up fighting too!
If you'd just done that... even planet Fleed...!
Don't make me laugh!
Bow our heads to mere Earthlings and beg, "Please let us live on Earth"...
You think we could ever say that!?
Like you did, Duke Fleed!
Zuril... Gandal... You bastards...!
Calm down, Duke Fleed.
Lose your cool and you'll lose even a winnable fight...! It's unavoidable now.
Sad, but... yeah.
Duke Fleed, what you should fear is not the enemy...
but losing yourself to rage!
...I won't hesitate anymore...! Vega Star Federation, prepare yourself!
Bring it on! All units, attack!
(This feeling... that girl...!?)
Kyaaaah!
Ah, Kirika...!?
Brother... the blazing planet... into a planet people can live on...
Impossible... Me, Zigra!? Me, of King Vega's Royal Guard!
This is the end!
Commander Zigra! We win!
Gwoooooooh!
To think... the Earthlings could go this far!
Not just Earthlings! Other planets, other worlds... Peace itself won!
I refuse! I refuse to accept it! I am of King Vega's Royal Gua...
Uoooh...! Juniorrrr!!
Nwoooh! K-King Vegaaaa!
Nuooooh!
Prepare yourself, you devil!
If it comes to this... I'll rain deadly fallout down on Earth...
King Vega, this is the end!
I am the king of the universe... King Vega...! Bwahahaha...
Hm! What's wrong, Maria!? It's dangerous!
You're... from back then... Kirika!?
Hey, why are you fighting for people like them?
I... want to make my brother's dream come true...
And for that, I have to fight for King Vega!
That's a lie! You heard it too, didn't you?
They're the kind who keep invading even after losing their own planet!
Your research will just be used for war too!
Then what am I supposed to do!? I've no home to go back to, no family...
How am I supposed to carry on my brother's wishes!?
Fight with us, for peace in the universe. Okay?
With all of you... But I did terrible things to Earth's people...
You left behind a Vegatron Minus Ray Gun
for my brother... There's kindness in your heart.
If someone like you fights for King Vega,
your brother would surely be sad too... right!?
Kindness... Brother... Brotherrr...!!
Maria, hurry! They'll pick you off!
Come on, transfer over here, quick!
O-Okay!
Acquired skill "Meditation".
Heh... Hahaha! With both Commander Gandal and Commander Zuril here,
you seem to be having an unexpectedly hard time!
Hm! Who goes there!?
More of 'em!?
The forces that already launched... came back!?
Didn't think you'd come from the other side! But too bad for you!
Now that we're here, you ain't doin' as you please.
With a force that small, against this Grendizer...
Hm!? That battleship...!?
What's that spaceship... It's sooo big...
Kukuku... Wahahaha! Long time, long time no see, Duke Fleed!
Brother, that voice!
......King Vega!
What!?
Eeek, the enemy king showed up!?
Gwahahaha! You came sooner than I thought, Duke Fleed.
Just when I was about to lead the attack on Earth myself!
What a thoughtless king, huh.
What if you come out yourself and get beaten?
Exactly... Is he panicking because he lost his planet?
I'm not a coward like you lot! Begone, brats!
You're really underestimating us...
Let me teach you that misjudging your opponent can be fatal!
Here we go, Domon! Saucers or monsters, let's take 'em all down!
King Vega, our showdown... ends here!
Who do you think I am!? I am the king of the universe, King Vega!
Commander Gandal, Commander Zuril, attack with all your might!
Yes, sire! Commander Gandal, we sortie as well!
Right, send out every last force we have! Prepare yourselves, Earthlings!
King Vega...!
Hmph, howl all you like!
This Skull Moon Base will be your grave!
We've come this far. No way we're losing now!
Fewer robots than our intel suggested.
Heh heh... Splitting your forces to take down this Skull Moon...
What naive thinking!
Don't flinch! We expected this much!
Crush them in one go!
I won't bow to a devil...!
Duke Fleed! You still dare defy me!?
There you are! You're late, Rom Stol!
Going back and forth was rough, you know? Some thanks would be nice.
That can wait till this battle's over. Then we'll take our time.
So we'll thank you till you're sick of it, OK?
Bah, how annoying! What difference do a few more make!?
No, this seals your defeat, King Vega! Prepare yourself!
Such is the fate of the Royal Guard.
Junior...?
I see... He had a family too......
We have to end this fight soon, so tragedies like this never repeat...
You defeated the enemy commander!
It's too soon to celebrate... Not until we defeat King Vega!
King Vega, this is your end!
Of planet Fleed... of the people of the many planets you sacrificed...
Feel their wrath!
Heh heh, so you've come, Duke Fleed... We have no planet to return to...
But I am King Vega, king of the universe! I'll never beg you for mercy!
Battle Mastery increased by 1.
It's over... At last... I've defeated King Vega...!
Brother... Brother, you did it, at last...
You did it, Daisuke.
Now you've finally gotten your revenge.
Looks like we've managed to thin out the forces attacking Earth too.
Umon, it seems your battle... is finally over.
...Yes. My fight as a man of Fleed is over.
Next, I'll fight as an Earthling, for this blue planet...!
Whew, I thought this was goodbye. Don't scare me like that.
It'd be a real problem if we lost Grendizer now.
Umon... looks like we'll be sticking together a while longer.
Yes, for the beautiful Earth...!
All right, we also need to consider our next course.
All units, return.
